caption:
Goodbye GTA 5 👋 13 years in numbers.

Sept 17, 2013 to Nov 19, 2026: three console generations, $800M+ on day one, ~230 million copies sold (Take-Two, May 2026), and the longest wait in GTA history.

Michael, Franklin or Trevor: who will you miss most? 👇

Facts checked: Take-Two filings and earnings, GTA Base / Game Informer release dates. Fan page, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
